تستوعبون (form X)
# تَسْتَوْعِبُونَ (tastawʕibūna) /tas.taw.ʕi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْعَبَ (istawʕaba)
# تُسْتَوْعَبُونَ (tustawʕabūna) /tus.taw.ʕa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْعَبَ (istawʕaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
